howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.lead: Three simple steps, whether you are looking for a home or offering one.

one.title: Search your way
one.text: Pick a city, dates and guests, then filter for a kosher kitchen, Shabbat-friendly homes or a synagogue nearby.

two.title: Check the details
two.text: Photos, the approximate location, Jewish-friendly details and the Verified badge help you choose with confidence.

three.title: Contact the owner directly
three.text: One tap opens WhatsApp, Telegram or a call with a ready message in your language. No booking fees.

one.title: List for free
one.text: Our step-by-step form takes a few minutes: photos, price, rooms and the details Jewish guests look for.

two.title: Get verified
two.text: We check every new listing. Verify your ID or property to earn the Verified badge and more trust.

three.title: Guests contact you
three.text: Guests reach you directly in the app you prefer. You decide who to host — with no commission.

listCta.title: List your property for free
listCta.text: Reach Jewish and Israeli travelers, families and investors looking for a home in Georgia. No fees — guests contact you directly.
